selection.method: Within-family raw/weighted Pareto fronts; raw-sorted incumbent removal sums with minimum-weight prefix lookup. Different families and incumbent are pairwise disjoint.

limits: All generated plans are proxy estimates, not trajectory certificates.
Failure tokens count recorded completion attempts, not mutually exclusive physical causes.
Four failed first-level completions have no stored reason. Earlier native pruning does not retain per-child rejection reasons.
No claim of global infeasibility or that a discarded prefix would have produced a useful route.
The workload changes family/seed geometry; its timing is not a paired speedup benchmark.
